Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: An employee expense-reimbursement claim (onkostendeclaratie / declaratie). An employee submits a claim (amount, category, date, receipt), a manager approves or rejects it, and once approved the amount is reimbursed to the employee. The submit → approve → reimburse lifecycle is owned here in humaniq, the HR/labour app — re-homing the Expenses feature that previously lived in pipelinq. The pipelinq-specific Shillinq accounts-payable sync coupling is intentionally NOT ported: reimbursement here is the HR-side claim workflow; any downstream AP/GL posting is a separate integration concern that OpenConnector/shillinq own.

submit.description: The employee submits the expense claim for manager approval. A rejected claim may be corrected and re-submitted.

approve.description: A manager approves the claim. The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-approval (the approver may not be the claiming employee); approvedBy and approvedAt are stamped on the carrying write.

reject.description: A manager rejects the claim (with a rejectionReason). The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-rejection. The employee may correct it and re-submit.

reimburse.description: The approved claim is paid out to the employee; reimbursedAt records the payout date. Terminal.

employeeId.title: Employee ID
employeeId.description: Who is claiming. This person cannot approve their own claim.
employeeId.x-notes: Reference to the Employee who submitted the claim (the claimant). Drives the self-approval guard — the approver may not equal this employee.

title.title: Title
title.description: A short title for the claim.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The amount claimed, in the currency below.
amount.x-notes: Claimed amount in the configured currency. Reused by OpenRegister aggregations for per-employee and per-status totals.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of the claim, for example EUR.

expenseDate.title: Expense date
expenseDate.x-notes: The date the expense was incurred (ISO 8601).

receiptFile.title: Receipt file
receiptFile.x-notes: Reference (Nextcloud Files path or OpenRegister file id) to the attached receipt / bon.

vendor.title: Vendor
vendor.description: Who the purchase was from. Filled in by you, or read off the receipt automatically.
vendor.x-notes: Vendor / leverancier name, either typed by the employee or prefilled by receipt-OCR extraction (receipt-ocr, REQ-RCPT-001).

vatAmount.title: VAT amount
vatAmount.description: The VAT on the receipt. Filled in by you, or read off the receipt automatically.
vatAmount.x-notes: VAT / BTW amount on the receipt, either typed by the employee or prefilled by receipt-OCR extraction (receipt-ocr, REQ-RCPT-001).

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this claim has got to: draft, submitted, approved or rejected, then reimbursed.
status.x-notes: Reimbursement workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine.

submittedAt.title: Submitted at
submittedAt.description: When the employee submitted the claim.
submittedAt.x-notes: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the employee submitted the claim.

approvedBy.title: Approved by
approvedBy.description: The manager who approved or rejected the claim. It cannot be the person who claimed.
approvedBy.x-notes: Nextcloud user ID of the manager who approved (or rejected) the claim — an NC user id, not an object FK, so it stays plain per ADR-046. Must differ from the claiming employee (no self-approval).

approvedAt.title: Approved at
approvedAt.description: When the claim was approved or rejected.
approvedAt.x-notes: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of approval or rejection.

rejectionReason.title: Rejection reason
rejectionReason.description: Reason the manager rejected the claim, shown to the employee so it can be corrected and re-submitted.

reimbursedAt.title: Reimbursed at
reimbursedAt.description: When the approved claim was paid out.
reimbursedAt.x-notes: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the approved claim was paid out to the employee.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The Nextcloud account this claim belongs to, so it appears under the employee's own expenses.
userId.x-notes: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee this expense claim belongs to (mijn-hr-self-service) — a plain NC-user-id string, mirroring the approvedBy convention, never a $ref relation. A copy of the linked Employee's nextcloudUserId, carried here because the manifest filter grammar cannot join across schemas. The MijnDeclaraties self-service page filters on it with the @me token.

managerUserId.title: Manager user id
managerUserId.description: The Nextcloud account of the employee's manager, so the claim reaches their approval queue.
managerUserId.x-notes: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee's manager (mss-team-scope) — a plain NC-user-id string, never a $ref relation. A copy of the nextcloudUserId of the manager (OrgUnit.managerId) of the record's employee's active OrgAssignment unit, populated by HR/back-office alongside userId because the manifest filter grammar cannot join across schemas. The TeamDeclaratiegoedkeuring team page filters on it with the @me token; audited by nl-mss-manager-consistency.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this claim belongs to. Normally the same as the employee's.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this Expense is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7, the PayrollRun/managerUserId convention), mirroring its employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007). The implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

travelType.title: Travel type
travelType.description: Whether these were business kilometres or commuting. Only fill this in for a travel claim with a distance.
travelType.x-notes: Distinguishes zakelijke kilometers (business) from woon-werkverkeer (commute) for a category travel claim -- both are eligible for the onbelaste kilometervergoeding (mileage-rules, REQ-MILE-001). Meaningful only alongside distanceKm; absent on non-mileage expenses.

distanceKm.title: Distance (km)
distanceKm.description: Kilometres driven for this claim. Used with the amount to check the tax-free rate per kilometre.
distanceKm.x-notes: Kilometers driven for this claim, used together with amount and travelType to compute the per-km reimbursement checked against the onbelaste kilometervergoeding by nl-reiskosten-onbelast-tarief (mileage-rules, REQ-MILE-001).

ReceiptExtraction.title: Receipt extraction
ReceiptExtraction.description: The humaniq-side record of one receipt-OCR extraction attempt against an Expense (receipt-ocr, REQ-RCPT-001): the raw extracted values and confidence docudesk's FinancialExtractionService returned, and which Expense fields this attempt actually wrote (appliedFields) -- the provenance trail a reviewer reads to see a value was machine-suggested rather than hand-entered. humaniq performs no OCR/extraction of its own; docudesk owns that surface entirely.

expenseId.title: Expense ID
expenseId.description: The claim this reading attempt belongs to.
expenseId.x-notes: Reference to the Expense this extraction attempt is for.

status.title: Status
status.description: The outcome of this extraction attempt.

overallConfidence.title: Overall confidence
overallConfidence.description: How confident the reader was overall. Empty until an attempt finishes.
overallConfidence.x-notes: docudesk's overall confidence score for this extraction; null until an attempt completes.

extractedAmount.title: Extracted amount
extractedAmount.description: The total amount read off the receipt, including VAT. Recorded even when it was not used because the field was already filled.
extractedAmount.x-notes: The raw amount docudesk extracted (VAT-inclusive total), recorded even when NOT applied because Expense.amount was already set.

extractedDate.title: Extracted date
extractedDate.description: The date read off the receipt. Recorded even when it was not used.
extractedDate.x-notes: The raw receipt/invoice date docudesk extracted, recorded even when NOT applied.

extractedVendor.title: Extracted vendor
extractedVendor.description: The supplier read off the receipt. Recorded even when it was not used.
extractedVendor.x-notes: The raw vendor/leverancier name docudesk extracted, recorded even when NOT applied.

extractedVatAmount.title: Extracted VAT amount
extractedVatAmount.description: The VAT read off the receipt. Recorded even when it was not used.
extractedVatAmount.x-notes: The raw VAT amount docudesk extracted, recorded even when NOT applied.

appliedFields.title: Applied fields
appliedFields.description: Which fields on the claim this attempt actually filled in. A value that was read but skipped because the field was already filled does not appear here.
appliedFields.x-notes: Comma-separated Expense field names this attempt actually wrote (a field extracted-but-skipped-because-already-filled does not appear here, even though its raw value is still recorded).

requestedBy.title: Requested by
requestedBy.description: Who asked for this extraction. Empty when it ran automatically.
requestedBy.x-notes: Nextcloud user ID that requested this extraction, plain string per ADR-046 (mirrors Expense.approvedBy), or null for 'system' (occ context).

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Why the reading failed or was skipped.
errorMessage.x-notes: Set on failed/skipped-no-docudesk; the diagnostic shown to the requester.

extractedAt.title: Extracted at
extractedAt.x-notes: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the extraction attempt completed.

objects.title: Werklunch klantbezoek Rotterdam
objects.description: Lunch met klant, kassabon bijgevoegd voor automatische receipt-extractie (receipt-ocr voorbeeld).
